trap.label: verbo + infinitivo/gerúndio
trap.why: Em português “parei de fumar” e “parei para fumar” se parecem. Em inglês stop to + base = parar PARA; stop + -ing = parar DE.

mcq.q: I stopped **___** my phone, so now I’m calmer. (parei de usar)
I remember **___** him. (lembro de ter visto)

fix.wrong: She stopped to check her phone all day.
fix.right: She stopped checking her phone all day.
I forgot to close the window.

fix.wrong: He remembered to meet her years ago.
fix.right: He remembered meeting her years ago.
